part1.title: Long Email? Ask AI These 3 Questions, Not Summarize #shorts
part1.description:
Don't ask AI to summarize a long email. Ask: what do they want from me, by when, and draft a 3-line reply. Then check names, dates and numbers yourself.
An original animated AI tip by zylo.

Follow for one AI trick a day.

#ai #chatgpt #aitips #productivity #shorts
